target_definition.metric: Henry Hub natural gas monthly return

graph_diagnosis.summary: Weather, heating demand, supply and storage, LNG balance, and geopolitical stability provide a reusable gas-balance framework.
weaknesses: Several anchors occur after the target period; the bridge is weak and requires current verification.

search_factors.why_search: Mild weather can reduce heating demand.
Ample production and storage can buffer demand shocks.
LNG balance affects global gas-market tightness.
Geopolitical stability or disruption can alter energy flows.

checkpoints.mechanism: Favorable weather can reduce heating demand.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Weather anomalies and demand data agree.

checkpoints.mechanism: Adequate supply and storage can buffer gas-balance shocks.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Production and storage data remain ample.

checkpoints.mechanism: Balanced LNG supply and demand can stabilize global gas conditions.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: LNG flows and global storage are balanced.

checkpoints.mechanism: Energy-market disruptions can upset stable supply assumptions.
Weather, demand, supply, storage, LNG flows, and disruptions combine to determine Henry Hub direction.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Verify current weather, demand, storage, production, LNG flows, and futures pricing.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Mild weather and ample supply can buffer the gas balance.
failure_conditions: Weather turns cold or supply disrupts.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: LNG disruptions and geopolitical risk can tighten balances.

alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare physical flow disruptions with storage and production.
